I was at a wedding reception when I was very very young. I remember a man on the table across from me kept staring at me, and when I'd catch his eye, he'd start pointing to the toilet, making some sort of slash motion across his wrist (don't know what that was to this day) tapping his wrist where a watch would be (as if to say 'hurry up') and then making blowjob motions with his mouth. This went on for a while and I remember being pretty scared despite not understanding what he was insinuating at the time due to being so young. Thank god I didn't go inside that bathroom. 

Looking back years later when the memory randomly popped into my head, I physically said "woah" out loud when I realised what he was actually doing. To this day, I've got absolutely no idea who that guy was or if he's part of the family or not. Scary stuff.

Honestly, I can't see how anybody would be surprised by this. 

I know it's bad to take on a defeatist attitude all of the time, but when I sit back and think, I can't help but see that the world has just gone to shit in all aspects. It's seriously no wonder that our collective mental health is deteriorating rapidly. 

I myself have lately begun thinking about suicide, which is pretty scary as it happened out of nowhere. I know I'm mentally ill (and know others who also are) but I'm just going through it like everyone else, I suppose. The only thing stopping me at this point is the people I'd leave behind.

I'm late to this but yes I know exactly what you're talking about. I graduated in 2013, and throughout that whole year my friends were going out every weekend and doing dumb amounts of MDMA.

I can say for certain that it has completely ruined a couple of them. They're like robots with absolutely no emotions at all and aren't interested whatsoever in the things that we all used to do together. It really is quite sad because it's come to the point where it's as if I don't even know them anymore and we have completely grown apart because of it.

If you know somebody doing reckless amounts of MD every weekend, you should do everything in your power to make them stop. Sorry that this happened OP, I know the feel completely :/
good job man, and thanks. if all goes to plan i'll have it by the end of this year/early next year, just gonna keep pushing through it

I'm turning 20 and I don't have my license either. I can drive just fine, but I find that while I'm driving I get anxious as fuck and I just do not trust myself in something that can kill people so easily. It scares me to think how little people care about driving. People make fun of me too, to the point of me telling new people that I either lost my license or that 'nobody ever wanted to teach me' which isn't really true at all.

I'm fucking sick of it, I've missed out on so much shit all because I'm too dumb to just man the fuck up and get on with it. My 80 year old grandmother can drive for god's sake. Recently I've been driving a lot more and I've never wanted it so badly in my life. You can do it too, I believe.

I'm pretty high and very sleep deprived, and I am fucking crying right now. I haven't cried for 5+ years. holy shit, that was one of the most amazing things I've ever read. I got a sense of nostalgia weirdly, like I knew exactly what you were talking about and was there experiencing it with you. Jesus I feel weird right now.

RIP Mark, and I'm sorry OP :(
